{{Quote|They're stirred up like a rats' nest down there.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Rats''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of small, [[Hair/Legends|furry]] [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]] considered vermin by many. They could be found on several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A prong-[[Nose/Legends|nosed]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] also lived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]. Rats were covered in [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]]; they had long, hairless tails and a sharp sense of smell. They would sometimes feed off [[Death/Legends|cadavers]]. Some of them were bred and kept for [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research.

==Biology and appearance==
Rats were quadrupedal, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]]<ref name="Blog" /> covered in a [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Color/Legends|gray]] coat. A rat had a hairless tail that was longer than its head and body combined,<ref name="ROTJ" /> and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] often deemed that tail "ugly."<ref name="CWG:S">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> They also had sensory whiskers on their faces.<ref name="ROTJ" /> There existed various [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of rats, including a prong-[[Nose/Legends|nosed]] one that lived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]. Those creatures had a sharp sense of smell, which allowed them to detect both their predators and potential food sources efficiently. On occasion, they would feed on abandoned [[Death/Legends|corpses]]. Like many other organics, rats could be killed by a violent punch in the neck.<ref name="Wrath" />

==Behavior and intelligence==
Packs of rats were led by their alpha females, which their whole warrens would follow everywhere.<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref> In case of danger, rats would creep in a hole to better hide.<ref name="CC">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

==Rats in the galaxy==
{{Quote|There's a locked grate to keep out rats and snake eyes and other vermin, but maintenance has the key codes.|[[Benedict Vidkun]]|<ref name="SOTE" />}}
Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a small group of gray-white rats had made their home in the [[Prison/Legends|dungeons]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on Tatooine. When the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partners [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were escorted in the dungeons to face Jabba's [[EV-9D9/Legends|supervisor droid]], three of those rats could be spotted on one set of prison bars.<ref name="ROTJ" />

In the wider [[galactic community]], rats were generally regarded as vermin.<ref name="SOTE" /> Humans often reacted to the presence of rats with disgust, sometimes kicking them casually,<ref name="HM">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref> and used their name to refer to contemptible persons.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> The [[Directors]], a trio of [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] criminals, were compared to "oversized pack rats" by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] named [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] called a group of scavenging [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] "tech-rats."<ref name="BSMH">{{StoryCite|story=Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Rats were to planetary surface what [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] were to [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="MHS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>

Various barriers, such as locked grates, were implemented to prevent them from entering dwellings through the sewers.<ref name="SOTE" /> They were sometimes fed [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] grain to get rid of them for good.<ref name="XW:WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

Some rats were used as test specimens in laboratory experiments.<ref name="Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
During the filming of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], a line on the prop list for the dungeon cell corridor read, "PROPS: Weapons, [[Unidentified power droid (Jabba's Palace)/Legends|Dustbin Droid]], Animals (4 rats to SB/Y)."<ref name="The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi">''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>
